criteria.criterion: `vloop intervention show <id>` prints the id and summary, the frontmatter fields, then each section under its name, then `links` with one line per id found in the Context section only, in order of first appearance.
criteria.evidence: internal/intervention/show.go Shown.Text prints id, summary, fields, sections, then links; Links scans v.Context only and dedupes in order of appearance. TestInterventionShowLinks checks the order, and the 'Note T9 also' id appears only in Context.

criteria.criterion: A defect id D<…> resolves to its summary; an intervention id I<…> to its summary; T<n> to the task's title in .vloop/state/state.json of the latest `[vloop] plan <run id>` commit for the record's brief; a 7-to-40-hex word git resolves to a commit to its subject; a run id B<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>-<slug> to its run folders under .vloop/state/runs/. An id that resolves to nothing prints `<ref>  (not found)`.
criteria.evidence: show.go resolve/taskTitle/commitSubject/runFolders implement each kind. taskTitle greps the latest plan commit and reads the plan via runs.PlanAt. The test has two plan commits plus a later drifted state.json and expects 'Latest title'. Each kind and the not-found case are asserted. Text prints '<ref>  (not found)'.

criteria.criterion: `--json` prints the record's JSON form plus `links: [{ref, kind, title}]`.
criteria.evidence: Shown.MarshalJSON appends links to the record JSON, and Links returns a non-nil slice. The test decodes the JSON and DeepEquals the links.

criteria.criterion: An unknown id exits 1 with `vloop: no intervention <id>` on stderr, and under --json prints `{"error": …}` on stdout as `vloop task show` does.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/intervention.go uses jsonProblem for NoInterventionError. The test asserts ExitProblems, empty stdout and the exact stderr text, and for --json the error field on stdout.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests cover each kind of link, not-found, the order, the JSON form and the unknown id.
criteria.evidence: TestInterventionShowLinks in internal/cli/intervention_test.go covers task, run, commit, defect and intervention links. It also covers not-found, the order, the JSON form, the text form and the unknown id in both modes.

notes: Any word of 7 to 40 hex characters in Context (e.g. 'decade', 'defaced') is treated as a commit ref and shown as not found, as the spec defines. No gate files or absolute paths were touched.
